offering_description.value: Owns and manages timberlands and sells harvested logs and standing timber to wood products mills, pulp producers and log exporters. Also sells some land for higher-value uses. Operates as a timberland real estate investment trust.

primary_products.value: sawlogs; pulpwood; export logs; timberland for sale

customer_segment.value: B2B: wood products mills, pulp and paper producers, log exporters, land buyers

end_markets.value: construction; paper and packaging; wood products; export

revenue_model.value: product sales: sawlogs, pulpwood and export logs sold to mills and exporters; other: sales of land for higher-value uses such as development or conservation

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: grows and harvests timber on owned land, sold to mills and exporters; asset operator: owns and manages timberland holdings in the US South, Pacific Northwest and New Zealand

geography_served.value: global: US South, Pacific Northwest and New Zealand, with log exports to Asian markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: timberland ownership, harvesting and log sales

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: log and timber sales to mills and exporters under contracts and spot sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: forestry, environmental and water rules from US state agencies and New Zealand's Ministry for Primary Industries
